1.explanation:
• DataTable/DataTable.mdx – primary documentation for the DataTable API; needs to document the new “md” rowSize option and demonstrate its effect on header and rows.
• DataTable/migrate-to-7.x.md – migration guide for v7; ensure customers know how to switch to the new row height option if upgrading.
• DataTable/state/ – example configurations and default state logic for the table; may need to adjust default rowHeight values in state samples.
• DataTable/stories/dynamic-content/ – story that renders a table with many rows; useful for visually testing that every row respects the new 40px height.
• DataTable/tools/ – helper functions that generate table data or default column definitions; might include mappings from a rowSize prop to actual CSS values.
• DataTableSkeleton/DataTableSkeleton.mdx – skeleton loader variant; skeleton rows must also align with the new 40px height to avoid layout shifts when transitioning to real data.
1.bug_scenario: The provided screenshot shows a DataTable with a new “md” row‐height variant set to 40px (2.5rem). Both the header row (light gray background, bold “Column header” text) and each data row (alternating white/light‐gray backgrounds, plain “cell text”) should be rendered at exactly 40px tall. The pink measurement callouts highlight that both header and body rows must use this new 40px (2.5rem) height, matching the design system’s medium size elsewhere.
